tvShow.name: LINK CLICK
tvShow.overview: Using superpowers to enter their clientele’s photos one by one, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang take their work seriously at “Time Photo Studio,” a small photography shop set in the backdrop of a modern metropolis. Each job can be full of danger, but nothing is more important than fulfilling every order, no matter the scale…or peril involved!

seasons.name: Link Click
seasons.overview:
It is said that a picture is worth a thousand words. In this case, it holds an infinite amount of secrets. These are secrets that only Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang are able to find. In a small shop called "Time Photo Studio," the two friends provide a special service: using their extraordinary powers that let them enter photographs, they jump into pictures brought to them by clients in order to grant their wishes. Through the eyes of the photographer, they live through the events surrounding the picture and try to decipher how to solve their client's request.

But every time they jump into a picture, they take a great risk. One wrong move and they could alter the future of the person who took the picture... and possibly countless other events too. So when the events they are forced to live through in these pictures start to become personal, it will take the utmost strength to push their feelings aside and focus on accomplishing the task they were paid to do.

episodes.name: Falling
episodes.overview: After the incident with Lu Guang, Cheng is forced to deal with the devastating situation and is forced to pay the debt as things begin to uncover.

episodes.name: Night Raid
episodes.overview: Cheng and Qiao Ling need to fight to solve the situation, while Inspector Xiao Li attends Inspector Chen Bin.

episodes.name: Two Funerals
episodes.overview: Cheng and Qiao encounter a familiar face that comes to their aid. However, they later find themselves at a funeral.

episodes.name: Them In The Photo
episodes.overview: Qian Jin continues to look for Liu Min's phone while Lu Guang and Cheng investigate the photo that was given to Lu Guang.

episodes.name: Last Supper
episodes.overview: Cheng and Lu Guang continue to investigate the photo but in doing so, they uncover the dark past that hid within the picture.

episodes.name: Li Tianxi
episodes.overview: Cheng begins to interrogate Li Tianxi unknowing of her intentions, in doing so, the police and the others stress, as things take a confusing turn.

episodes.name: Urban Warfare
episodes.overview: As Li Tianxi and Cheng continue their ulterior motive, inspectors Xiao Li and Wang Juan indulge in a physical and psychological battle in hopes to expose their intentions.

episodes.name: Hostage
episodes.overview: With Lu Guangs sudden interference Cheng and Qiao are left perplexed and saved, however, things take a sharp turn ruining the situation even more.

episodes.name: Three Stories
episodes.overview: As Cheng continues his mission in the past, Li Tianchen and Qian Jin's backstories uncover, revealing their true natures.

episodes.name: Improvise
episodes.overview: After learning the secrets to Li Tianchen's powers, Cheng comes up with a strategy to try and save Lu Guang but things don't end up going as planned.

episodes.name: Confrontation
episodes.overview: Cheng comes up with a tactical strategy to try and save both himself and Lu Guang, however Qian Jing proves that he is one step ahead and things end up going unexpectedly for both sides.

episodes.name: Can't Live Without a Good Brother
episodes.overview: There are rules, and they must be followed. What is the price to pay when one of them is broken?

seasons.name: Link Click 2
seasons.overview:
The attempt to capture the mysterious perpetrator who possesses people ends tragically: Lu Guang is rushed to the hospital in a critical state, while Cheng Xiaoshi is arrested for the alleged crime. In light of recent events, the father of Liu Min unleashes his skilled, ruthless lawyer—Qian Jin—after Police Chief Li Xiao, who is spearheading the investigation related to the photo studio owned by Qiao Ling.

It appears that no one is safe from the unpredictable and fatal attacks of the adversary who painstakingly hides their identity. As he tries to learn from his past mistakes, Cheng Xiaoshi must act swiftly and decisively to put an end to this devastating trail of death.

episodes.name: So Time Begins to Flow Again
episodes.overview: Lu Guang goes back in time to where it all began.

episodes.name: Prelude
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi finds a photograph of the city of Bridon, apparently sent by his father. At the same time, a series of scams taking place in the same locality are making headlines in the news. Knowing him, he will not hesitate to go to Lu Guang to uncover the mystery.

episodes.name: Them
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang arrive in Bridon in search of clues to solve the mystery of Cheng Xiaoshi's father. When they reach the airport, problems immediately arise for them…

episodes.name: And Then There Were None
episodes.overview: The mysterious boss of Xia Fei comes to the boys' rescue, but after the first exchange of words, Lu Guang notices that something isn't right.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: After witnessing the academy fire, Cheng Xiaoshi understands his power thanks to Lu Guang, and they try to find out who survived the disaster.

episodes.name: Puzzle
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi finally manages to talk to Vein, but to help him, Vein demands that he and Lu Guang help him replace a fired model.

seasons.name: Bridon Arc
seasons.overview: In order to save the deceased Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang returned to the beginning and started anew along the path of destiny. However, a photograph carrying clues about Cheng Xiaoshi's parents appeared at the Time Photo Studio. To uncover the truth, Lu Guang, with a heart full of anxiety, went to Yingdu with Cheng Xiaoshi. Facing people with different purposes, such as the seemingly friendly popular model Xia Fei, the eccentric leader of Chinatown Vein, and the mysteriously appearing Liu Xiao... can Lu Guang break the destined dead end?

seasons.name: Link Click 3
seasons.overview: After the Li Tianchen incident came to an end, the Time Photo Studio returned to a superficial calm. However, the news of Xia Fei's disappearance once again plunged everyone into the crossroads of fate. With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's awakening powers, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang gradually uncover the secrets of the Bahati fire case. Cheng Xiaoshi's father, Cheng Weimin, and mother, Shao Yuanyuan, also seemed to have intricate connections to it. As the investigation deepens, Liu Xiao, from a mysterious organization, begins his actions, and the intervention of Bridon police officer Jae adds uncertainty to this quest for the truth.
